title_zh: 请修复人员评估破损书脊

scenario.label_zh: 破损书籍的暂存与修复评估
scenario.goal_zh: 说明书脊损坏、确认可留存评估并要求修复前说明方案

context_zh: 访客 Victor 带一本旧书到书籍修复工作室，接待员 Mei 负责登记。
author: author-phase12-b

sentences.speaker: Victor
sentences.text: The spine is coming away from the cover. Is that a straightforward repair?

sentences.speaker: Mei
sentences.text: It may not be. Our conservator needs to look at the binding before we can describe the work.

sentences.speaker: Victor
sentences.text: Can I leave it here? I’m also unsure about storage while it waits.

sentences.speaker: Mei
sentences.text: Yes. I’ll register it for assessment, and the conservator will decide where to keep it here.

sentences.speaker: Victor
sentences.text: Please do. I’d like an explanation of the proposed repair before I agree to any work.
